summary_md:
Today’s batch is heavy on operational turnarounds. DGXX is the clearest positive story—its AI data center buildout is on track and already generating revenue. BEEP’s parking-portfolio inflection is attracting institutional buying, while NTRP’s pivot is met with sharp skepticism and OPAL’s green gas growth remains a show-me story. Insider buying punctuates several names: HNRG’s director increased his stake, and JCTC’s 10% owner bought into a painful but deliberate exit from unprofitable lines.

Utilities UTL and RGCO hold up well—UTL at a 52-week high, RGCO upgraded after candidly managing an LNG outage. Restructuring themes run through CULP and EML. IMSR’s nuclear ambition is aspirational but unproven, and UFI is waiting for tariffs to spark demand. ALTG, CVR, NC, and STRS generated no relevant narrative.
